column3: “Head of every road” is rendered “beginning of every street,” and “mound” as “shrine.”
“Lust” is rendered “lewdness”; the word is uncertain.
“Judgments of adulteresses” is rendered “like women who commit adultery … are judged.”
“Bring up a company” is rendered “incite a crowd.”
“Like a little only” is rendered “as if that were too little.”
“Just when I saw” follows the Hebrew “when I saw”; some manuscripts read “as you have seen.”
“Turn back their captivity” is rendered “restore their captivity.”
“Become a mention” is rendered “the name … was not heard.”
The Hebrew has “Aram”; NASB has “Edom,” following many manuscripts.
“You will bear them” is rendered as past, “You have borne the penalty.”
